name: Drowat
source:
One of the three siblings who serve Jean in the "Goddess Church". She is a cloned human being.

Good relationship with her origin, Miryu. She is a shy girl and often hides behind Jean.

"Wow, I'm going to do something! What should I do!?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
